CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION academy_private.valid_work(p_restaurant text, p_department text, p_position text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(p_restaurant in ('minsk','pushkino','khimki','mytishchi') and (
 (p_department='Зал' and p_position in ('Официант','Администратор зала','Хостес')) or
 (p_department='Бар' and p_position in ('Старший бармен','Барбэк','Бармен','Бар-менеджер')) or
 (p_department='Кухня' and p_position in ('Повар','Шеф-повар')) or
 (p_department='Арт' and p_position='Сотрудник арт') or
 (p_department='Кальян' and p_position in ('Кальянный мастер','Старший кальянный мастер')) or
 (p_department='Руководитель' and p_position in ('Руководитель','Управляющий'))),false)
$function$

constraints.name: academy_operations_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT operations_director) OR COALESCE(((role = 'manager'::text) AND (department = 'Руководитель'::text) AND ("position" = 'Операционный директор'::text) AND (restaurant_id IS NULL)), false)))

constraints.name: academy_single_operations_person
constraints.definition: CHECK (((id = 'd4c13a7d-27c6-434d-812b-6bd477166573'::uuid) OR ((NOT operations_director) AND ("position" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Операционный директор'::text))))

constraints.name: academy_venue_director_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT venue_director) OR COALESCE(((role = 'manager'::text) AND (NOT operations_director) AND ("position" = 'Управляющий'::text) AND (department = 'Руководитель'::text) AND (restaurant_id = ANY (ARRAY['minsk'::text, 'pushkino'::text, 'khimki'::text, 'mytishchi'::text]))), false)))
